subject.title: Gateway Dashboard chat buttons lose busy state after tab switch and can interrupt active runs

question: Should maintainers repair this on current main, revive the linked PR, or wait for a different replacement before closing this issue?
rationale: The issue is valid at source level and has an open closing PR, but current main has moved the UI/Gateway surfaces enough that maintainer routing is needed before starting another repair lane.

options.title: Repair on current main
options.body: Narrow the fix around the current `hasAbortableSessionRun`/send-gating path and close or supersede the stale linked PR afterward.

options.title: Revive the linked PR
options.body: Ask the contributor to rebase https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/41067 onto current main and add redacted live Dashboard proof.

options.title: Wait for replacement proof
options.body: Keep the issue open until another proof-positive PR covers the tab-switch busy-state and send/queue behavior.

recommendation.title: Repair on current main
recommendation.body: Narrow the fix around the current `hasAbortableSessionRun`/send-gating path and close or supersede the stale linked PR afterward.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged adjacent PR owns the current `hasActiveRun` recovery behavior that the remaining fix must extend into send/queue gating.
